column1: # Lint suppressions that predate the rule in `.rules` requiring a reason.
# These are the attributes whose justification is not recoverable from the code:
# a `#[allow(missing_docs)]` on an item with no doc comment says nothing about
# why the documentation was skipped, and eight `dead_code`/`unused` attributes
# name code whose only caller is not in this tree. Rather than invent a reason,
# the gate accepts these until someone who knows the item documents it or
# The count column is what keeps the file shrinking. `cargo xtask check
# lint-suppressions` fails when a row's count no longer matches the tree, in
# either direction: removing a suppression forces the row down, and adding one
# forces a reason instead of a silent bump.
